cause.description: The cause of a status that is not a verdict.

value.description: The measured value, when there is one.

description:
One run: whether it is sealed, what it was read from, the provenance and the other values it
measured, and its outcomes with their evidence.

catalog.description:
The tool catalog the run ran with, as the run stored it: the canonical form of the
snapshot without `captured_at`. Absent when the run has no stored snapshot.

experiment.description: The digest of the experiment the run belongs to.

host.description: The host the run was made on.

import.description: What the run was imported from, for an imported run.

integrity.description: The integrity verdict of the manifest.

job.description: The job that made the run.

measured.description: The other measured values, by path.

outcomes.description: The outcomes of the run, ordered by evaluator, then expectation, then newest request.

provenance.description: The measured values under `provenance.`, by path.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `inspect-run/1`.

title: InspectRun
